svg.title: Experience timeline of Alex Földvári, 2022 to today
svg.desc: Horizontal timeline from January 2022 to today. January 2022 to March 2024: HelixLab Kft in Pécs, Frontend Developer (Angular). April 2024 to April 2025: studies and own projects. May 2025 to March 2026: Dynex Kft in Budapest, Full-Stack Developer and Technical Lead. April 2026 to now: self-employed in Zürich, building Solory; the blue bar ends at a tick marked NOW. Milestones: September 2024, BSc Business Informatics studies start; November 2025, 1st place in a university research competition. On load the axis draws once from left to right with the bars following it, then the card stays still.
